= Protocols by Equipment =

This page shows which protocols use each piece of equipment, demonstrating the interconnection between equipment and protocols.

== Equipment and Their Required Protocols ==

For each piece of equipment, this query shows all protocols that require it:

{{#ask:
[[Category:Equipment]]
[[Status::Active]]
|?Required Equipment
|format=broadtable
|link=all
|headers=plain
|mainlabel=Equipment
|order=ASC
|sort=Equipment Type
}}

== Protocols and Their Equipment Requirements ==

For each protocol, this query shows all equipment it requires:

{{#ask:
[[Category:Protocol]]
[[Status::Active]]
|?Required Equipment
|?Protocol Version
|format=table
|link=all
|headers=plain
|mainlabel=Protocol
|order=ASC
|sort=Protocol
}}

== Equipment Usage Summary ==

This shows how many protocols use each piece of equipment:

{{#ask:
[[Category:Equipment]]
[[Status::Active]]
|?Required Equipment
|format=table
|link=all
|headers=plain
|mainlabel=Equipment
|order=DESC
|sort=Required Equipment
}}
